author: mark
text:
CI: configure git identity on the runner

Two integration tests were panicking on the GitHub runner with
`fatal: empty ident name (for <runner@…>) not allowed` because a
fresh ubuntu-latest image has no global git user.email or user.name
and the tests shell out to real git (commit / rebase). Setting the
identity at the workflow layer unblocks tarpaulin and lets the 100%
coverage gate enforce on every push. Supersedes bl-45e7.
